Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA), student questionnaire

The OECD's assessment of 15-year-old students in reading, mathematics and science, with a student questionnaire, every three years since 2000 (2022 was delayed a year). Each cycle is its own database. This repo covers the student questionnaire file of the 2012, 2015, 2018 and 2022 cycles.

Publisher
Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html
OECD Terms and Conditions: data may be extracted, downloaded, copied, adapted, printed, distributed, shared and embedded for any purpose, even commercial, with credit to the OECD using the dataset's citation. Written content published since 1 July 2024 is CC BY 4.0; earlier written content may be used, copied, distributed and adapted with citation, but commercial translation needs authorisation. Allen Downey decided on 2026-11-19 that data, documentation and metadata ship and that LLM processing is allowed, with an OECD credit as the notice.
wave
cycle — The assessment year. Each cycle is one release, so a release holds one wave.
form
questionnaire form — 2012 only: the student questionnaire rotated three forms (A, B, C) and a short one-hour form (UH); QuestID says which a student had. The sense-of-belonging question (ST87) is on forms B and C.
